answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 36641 Country: India Title: One of my friends, Ahmed committed a mistake two weeks ago Question: One of my friends, Ahmed committed a mistake two weeks ago. He committed adultery with one of his mahram women. Now he felt very upset, but both are married person. Due to bad time he did so. Could you please advise what can they do in future? But I frankly said to them, please do istighfar. Hope in future they are not doing it next time in-sha-Allah. Answer ID: 36641 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 287/L=186/TL=1433) Now they should do taubah and istighfar wholeheartedly. Also they should make firm intention not to repeat this act in future. Also they should completely avoid meeting and talking etc. This is the kaffarah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
